energy.title: Mexico’s National Energy Commission approves 6 solar energy permits worth US $750M
energy.summary: Mexico approved six photovoltaic power generation permits with investments totaling US $750 million, adding 649 MW of capacity to the grid.

highlight.zh: 国行第8次维持隔夜政策利率2.75%，明年首季或升至3%，RM50万房贷月供或多还73令吉；网传公积金可提领1万令吉是骗局，公众须提高警惕。
highlight.en: Bank Negara kept the overnight policy rate at 2.75% for an 8th straight meeting, but a Q1 2027 hike to 3% is possible, potentially adding RM73 monthly to a RM500,000 home loan. Also, claims of RM10,000 EPF withdrawals are a scam.
